title: Anatomy-Aware Dexterity-Driven Design Optimization of Surgical Continuum Robots
summary: Performing complex medical procedures with continuum robots requires careful selection of their geometric design parameters. The robot should have high dexterity in the specific anatomical environment of its procedure. This work presents a design optimization method that considers both dexterity and anatomy. We introduce the Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle (RVDSA) metric as our objective, which measures the ability of a robot's end effector to reach the points in a goal volume from different directions via collision-free paths from a start configuration. We present a computationally efficient motion planner to compute this objective function for a given robotic design, and we use an asymptotically optimal simulated annealing optimizer to compute an optimized design. We applied our new method to optimize the design of a bimanual dexterous sheaths robot for performing procedures on cancerous polyps in colon anatomies, achieving a 78% higher RVDSA on average than optimizing for 3D voxel coverage alone.
tldr: This paper proposes an anatomy-aware design optimization framework for surgical continuum robots using a new Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle (RVDSA) metric, a computationally efficient motion planner, and simulated annealing. Applied to a bimanual dexterous sheath robot for colon polyp procedures, it achieves 78% higher RVDSA on average than voxel-coverage-only optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向手术连续体机器人的解剖感知设计优化方法，引入了新的可达体积灵巧立体角（RVDSA）指标，结合高效运动规划器和模拟退火优化器。在结肠息肉手术的双臂灵巧鞘管机器人设计中，RVDSA平均比仅优化三维体素覆盖率高出78%。
summary_zh: 使用连续体机器人执行复杂医疗程序时，需要仔细选择其几何设计参数。机器人在其手术的特定解剖环境中应具有高灵巧度。本工作提出了一种同时考虑灵巧度和解剖结构的设计优化方法。我们引入可达体积灵巧立体角（RVDSA）指标作为优化目标，该指标衡量机器人的末端执行器从起始构型出发，通过无碰撞路径从不同方向到达目标体积内各点的能力。我们提出了一种计算效率高的运动规划器来计算给定机器人设计的目标函数，并使用渐近最优的模拟退火优化器来计算优化设计。我们将新方法应用于优化双臂灵巧鞘管机器人的设计，以在结肠解剖结构中对癌性息肉执行手术，与仅优化三维体素覆盖率相比，平均RVDSA提高了78%。

title: CRC-Router: Risk-Constrained Routing for Medical Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being explored in medical imaging to improve throughput and reduce clinician workload; however, safe deployment remains challenging because autonomous errors may propagate into downstream clinical decisions. A central requirement is therefore not only strong predictive performance, but also a reliable routing mechanism that determines when the system should proceed autonomously and when a case should be escalated for further review. To address this gap, we propose CRC-Router, a risk-constrained, uncertainty-aware routing module that is applicable to both conventional medical prediction models and agentic medical AI systems. CRC-Router combines multiple complementary uncertainty signals with the predictive score to construct a per-finding routing feature vector, maps this vector to an estimated wrong-accept risk using a lightweight per-finding risk model, and then applies Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to calibrate acceptance thresholds under a user-specified risk target. Instantiated on chest X-ray multi-finding triage using the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, CRC-Router achieves the strongest empirical risk--coverage trade-off among the evaluated baselines, both as a standalone routing layer and as a plug-in module integrated with the state-of-the-art MedRAX agent. These results demonstrate both the effectiveness of CRC-Router in selective medical automation and its modular, model-agnostic compatibility with existing predictive and agentic medical pipelines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/XLIAaron/CRC-Router
tldr: Proposes CRC-Router, a risk-constrained, uncertainty-aware routing module for medical agentic AI systems. It combines predictive scores with multiple uncertainty signals, estimates wrong-accept risk, and uses conformal risk control to calibrate acceptance thresholds, improving risk-coverage trade-off on chest X-ray triage and integrating with the MedRAX agent.
tldr_zh: 提出CRC-Router，一种用于医学智能体系统的风险约束、不确定性感知路由模块。它结合预测分数与多种不确定性信号，估计错误接受风险，并通过保形风险控制校准自动接受阈值；在胸部X光多发现分诊任务上取得了更好的风险-覆盖权衡，且可作为插件与MedRAX智能体集成。
summary_zh:
摘要：
智能体AI系统在医学影像中的应用日益增多，以提高处理效率并减轻临床医生的工作负担；然而，安全部署仍具挑战性，因为自主错误可能传播到下游临床决策中。因此，一个核心要求不仅是强大的预测性能，还需要一个可靠的路由机制，用于确定系统何时应自主运行，以及何时应将病例升级以进一步审查。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了CRC-Router，一种风险约束、不确定性感知的路由模块，适用于传统医学预测模型和智能体医学AI系统。CRC-Router将多个互补的不确定性信号与预测分数相结合，构建每个发现的路由特征向量；通过轻量级的每个发现风险模型，将该向量映射到估计的错误接受风险；随后应用共形风险控制（CRC）在用户指定的风险目标下校准接受阈值。在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集上，我们以胸部X射线多发现分诊任务为实例对CRC-Router进行了验证，它在所评估的基线方法中取得了最强的经验风险-覆盖率权衡，既可作为独立路由层，也可作为与最先进的MedRAX智能体集成的插件模块。这些结果证明了CRC-Router在选择性医学自动化中的有效性，以及其与现有预测和智能体医学流程的模块化、模型无关兼容性。代码公开发布于 https://github.com/XLIAaron/CRC-Router

title: Structured Reasoning Agentic Framework for Interpretable Critical View of Safety Assessment
summary: Surgical scene understanding is critical for computer-assisted intervention, yet laparoscopic cholecystectomy remains challenged by the complex anatomy of the hepatocystic triangle and the risk of bile duct injury. Existing methods for Critical View of Safety (CVS) assessment typically treat it as a holistic prediction task, mapping visual features directly to criterion-level labels. This black-box paradigm lacks explicit reasoning about anatomical relationships, limiting both interpretability and compositional generalization. To address this, we propose ReasonCVS, a structured reasoning agentic framework empowered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that decomposes CVS assessment into explicit, fine-grained anatomical verification. Specifically, we devise an Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA) that organizes anatomical entities and their spatial relationships into a structured representation. To operationalize this, we introduce a Rationale-Aware Reasoning Agent, powered by a Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuned via rationale distillation. Functioning as a strict central decision-maker, it invokes VLM-driven Sub-criterion Verifier as a specialized perceptual tool to parse the graph and independently evaluate individual sub-criteria. Through calibrated soft reasoning, this agent synthesizes the tool-gathered distributed observations, yielding a final verdict alongside a traceable clinical rationale. Extensive experiments on the Endoscapes-CVS201 benchmark demonstrate that ReasonCVS achieves superior performance (68.1\% mAP) over state-of-the-art while providing interpretable, criterion-level explanations for reliable surgical assessment.
tldr: The paper proposes ReasonCVS, a structured reasoning agentic framework using VLMs and an LLM-based reasoning agent to make Critical View of Safety (CVS) assessment in laparoscopic cholecystectomy interpretable. It decomposes CVS into an anatomical scene graph, verifies sub-criteria via VLM tools, and produces traceable clinical rationale, achieving 68.1% mAP on Endoscapes-CVS201.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 ReasonCVS，一种基于视觉语言模型和大型语言模型的结构化推理智能体框架，将腹腔镜胆囊切除术中的安全关键视野（CVS）评估分解为解剖场景图验证，并通过子标准验证工具生成可解释的临床依据，在 Endoscapes-CVS201 上取得 68.1% mAP 的先进结果。
summary_zh: 外科场景理解对于计算机辅助干预至关重要，然而腹腔镜胆囊切除术仍面临肝胆囊三角区解剖结构复杂及胆管损伤风险的挑战。现有的安全关键视野（CVS）评估方法通常将其视为整体预测任务，直接将视觉特征映射到标准级别标签。这种黑盒范式缺乏对解剖关系的显式推理，限制了解释性和组合泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ReasonCVS，一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的结构化推理智能体框架，将CVS评估分解为显式、细粒度的解剖验证。具体而言，我们设计了一种解剖场景图抽象（ASGA）方法，将解剖实体及其空间关系组织为结构化表示。为实现这一框架，我们引入了一种基于理性感知的推理智能体，其核心是由通过理性蒸馏微调的大语言模型（LLM）驱动。该智能体作为严格的中枢决策者，调用由VLM驱动的子标准验证器作为专门的感知工具，以解析场景图并独立评估各个子标准。通过校准的软推理，该智能体综合工具收集的分布式观测结果，最终给出裁决以及可追溯的临床理性依据。在Endoscopes-CVS201基准上的大量实验表明，ReasonCVS实现了优于现有最先进方法的性能（68.1% mAP），同时提供了可解释的、标准级别的解释，以实现可靠的手术评估。

title: A Safety-Bounded SDC-to-MCP Gateway for Medical AI Agents
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a common interface through which AI applications discover and use external resources and tools. It allows language-model agents to ground their reasoning in current system state and interact with heterogeneous services. In medical environments, however, exposing device state and action affordances requires deterministic constraints on possible effects. We present an IEEE 11073 Service-Oriented Device Connectivity (SDC)-to-MCP gateway that exposes metrics, alarms, context references, and semantic metadata as read-only resources, while representing selected action affordances as policy-validated dry-run tools. The term safety-bounded denotes a narrow no-execution property: agent-facing requests dispatch no SDC device operation. A Python prototype supports simulated fault and lifecycle experiments, a software-reference protocol path spanning independent Java and Python implementations, deterministic baselines, representation ablations, and multi-model agent evaluation. The results show semantically explicit resource exposure, visible rejection of invalid or outdated state, and preservation of the no-execution boundary across resource, proposal, and authorization paths. Explicit semantic metadata improved conformity to required metric identifiers in structured alarm outputs relative to a generic representation, while retained structured-output failures reveal a distinction between plausible narrative answers and task-compliant machine-readable results.
tldr: Presents a safety-bounded gateway between IEEE 11073 SDC medical devices and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), exposing metrics/alarms as read-only resources and action affordances as policy-validated dry-run tools with a strict no-execution boundary. Evaluations show semantically explicit resource exposure, rejection of invalid/outdated state, and preserved safety constraints across resource, proposal, and authorization paths.
tldr_zh: 提出一种安全受限的IEEE 11073 SDC到MCP网关，将医疗设备指标/警报作为只读资源暴露，将操作能力作为策略验证的dry-run工具，并严格保持不执行SDC设备操作的边界。实验表明其能语义明确地暴露资源、拒绝无效/过期状态，并在资源、提案和授权路径上维持安全约束。
summary_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）提供了一种通用接口，AI应用程序通过该接口发现并使用外部资源和工具。它使语言模型智能体能够基于当前系统状态进行推理，并与异构服务交互。然而，在医疗环境中，暴露设备状态和操作能力需要对可能产生的效果施加确定性约束。我们提出了一种IEEE 11073面向服务的设备连接（SDC）到MCP的网关，该网关将指标、报警、上下文引用和语义元数据作为只读资源暴露，同时将选定的操作能力表示为经策略验证的试运行工具。术语“安全受限”表示一种严格的不可执行属性：面向智能体的请求不会触发任何SDC设备操作。一个Python原型支持模拟故障和生命周期实验、跨越独立Java和Python实现的软件参考协议路径、确定性基线、表示消融实验以及多模型智能体评估。结果表明，该方案实现了语义明确的资源暴露、对无效或过期状态的可见拒绝，并在资源、提议和授权路径上保持了不可执行边界。与通用表示相比，显式语义元数据提高了结构化报警输出中对所需指标标识符的符合度，而保留的结构化输出失败则揭示了看似合理的叙述性回答与符合任务的机器可读结果之间的区别。

title: MACBT: A Multi-Agent Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Decision Support System with Longitudinal Memory
summary: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is an evidence-based first-line treatment for depression, yet its scale is constrained by the time clinicians spend on pre-session preparation, post-session documentation, and longitudinal cognitive-pathology tracking. We present a clinician-facing AI decision-support system that combines a multi-agent CBT framework (MACBT) with a CBT-specific longitudinal memory module (CD Memory). MACBT encodes the five-stage CBT workflow (assessment, Socratic questioning, cognitive restructuring, behavioral experiments, and treatment monitoring) into five collaborative agents. CD Memory tracks cognitive-distortion type, frequency, severity, and restructuring efficacy across sessions to generate pre-session pathology reports and intervention-priority recommendations. We construct a Chinese CBT dialogue corpus via dual-role large language model simulation and train a Qwen3-14B backbone with supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Evaluation with GPT-4 judges shows MACBT outperforms MeChat, SoulChat, PsyChat, and CPsyCounX in professionalism (2.62) and clinical authenticity (2.25). The full memory-augmented system further improves session quality by 12.6% and achieves a longitudinal mean of 2.29 on cross-session continuity, intervention progression, and personalization.
tldr: This paper proposes MACBT, a clinician-facing multi-agent decision-support system for cognitive behavioral therapy, with a CBT-specific longitudinal memory module that tracks cognitive distortions across sessions. It trains a Qwen3-14B backbone on a simulated Chinese CBT corpus and reports improved professionalism, clinical authenticity, and longitudinal continuity over existing mental-health chatbots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 MACBT，一种面向临床医生的认知行为疗法多智能体决策支持系统，并配备专门追踪跨会话认知扭曲的纵向记忆模块。该系统在模拟生成的中文CBT语料上训练了 Qwen3-14B 模型，报告其在专业性、临床真实性和跨会话连续性上优于现有心理健康聊天机器人。
summary_zh: 认知行为疗法（CBT）是抑郁症循证一线治疗方法，但其推广规模受限于临床医生在治疗前准备、治疗后记录以及纵向认知病理追踪上所花费的时间。我们提出了一种面向临床医生的AI决策支持系统，该系统将多智能体CBT框架（MACBT）与CBT特异性纵向记忆模块（CD Memory）相结合。MACBT将CBT五阶段工作流程（评估、苏格拉底式提问、认知重构、行为实验和治疗监测）编码为五个协作智能体。CD Memory跨会话追踪认知歪曲类型、频率、严重程度及重构效果，以生成会话前病理报告和干预优先级建议。我们通过双角色大语言模型模拟构建了中文CBT对话语料库，并采用监督微调和直接偏好优化训练Qwen3-14B主干模型。基于GPT-4评估者的评测显示，MACBT在专业性（2.62）和临床真实性（2.25）方面优于MeChat、SoulChat、PsyChat和CPsyCounX。完整的记忆增强系统进一步将会话质量提升12.6%，并在跨会话连续性、干预进展和个性化方面达到纵向均值2.29。

title: PICO: Projection-Informed Consistency Optimisation for 6DoF Surgical Tool Pose Estimation
summary: Purpose: Accurate 6 DoF pose estimation of surgical tools is critical for automa- tion, robotic proprioception, and safe interaction with the tissue operated on. Kinematics-based approaches suffer from accumulated errors due to the cable- driven nature of robotic arms, while vision-based methods often rely on external markers or trackers. Although more recent vision-based advances have been pro- posed, these two-stage pose estimation methods often lack real-time robustness due to accumulated errors and computational overhead. Methods: We propose a novel end-to-end trainable model, PICO. Our model employs a multi-task learning architecture to predict segmentation and depth maps, alongside regression of translation and rotation parameters. We define two proxy tasks that enforce geometric consistency in both 2D and 3D spaces, improving accuracy and robustness. For this, we propose a projection loss, and a point-to-point loss. Results: We evaluate our method on the SurgRIPE dataset, benchmarking its performance against state-of-the-art approaches using standard 6DoF pose esti- mation metrics. Our results demonstrate consistently strong performance across all four subsets, specifically in rotation, ranking second even under occlusion. It also demonstrates comparable translational performance, remaining competitive, especially in occluded cases. Conclusion: PICO demonstrates the effectiveness of multi-task learning and geometry-aware proxy tasks for robust and reliable surgical tool pose estimation, especially in occluded scenarios, highlighting potential for future applications.
tldr: PICO is an end-to-end multi-task model for 6DoF surgical tool pose estimation that jointly predicts segmentation, depth, translation, and rotation, and uses projection and point-to-point consistency losses to improve geometric accuracy and occlusion robustness; evaluated on SurgRIPE, it achieves strong rotation performance and competitive translation, especially under occlusion.
tldr_zh: PICO 是一种端到端多任务学习模型，用于手术器械 6DoF 位姿估计；它联合预测分割、深度以及平移和旋转参数，并通过投影一致性与点对点损失增强几何一致性，在 SurgRIPE 数据集上尤其在遮挡场景下表现出较强的旋转精度和具有竞争力的平移精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：目的：外科手术工具的精确六自由度（6 DoF）位姿估计对于自动化、机器人本体感知以及与手术组织的安全交互至关重要。基于运动学的方法因机械臂的缆绳驱动特性而存在累积误差，而基于视觉的方法往往依赖外部标记或追踪器。尽管近年来提出了更先进的基于视觉的方法，但这些两阶段位姿估计方法常因累积误差和计算开销而缺乏实时鲁棒性。方法：我们提出了一种新颖的端到端可训练模型PICO。该模型采用多任务学习架构，在回归平移和旋转参数的同时，预测分割图和深度图。我们定义了两个代理任务，以在二维和三维空间中强制几何一致性，从而提高精度和鲁棒性。为此，我们提出了投影损失和点对点损失。结果：我们在SurgRIPE数据集上评估了我们的方法，并使用标准6DoF位姿估计指标将其性能与最先进的方法进行了基准比较。结果表明，我们的方法在所有四个子集上均表现出一致的强劲性能，尤其在旋转方面，即使在遮挡情况下也排名第二。同时，它在平移方面表现出可比的性能，保持竞争力，尤其是在遮挡场景中。结论：PICO证明了多任务学习和几何感知代理任务在实现稳健可靠的手术工具位姿估计方面的有效性，尤其是在遮挡场景下，凸显了其未来应用的潜力。

title: Learning-Based Pressure Predictive Control of a Vertebraic Soft Robotic Tail
summary: Soft robots have attracted much attention for their safe human-robot interaction and flexibility, but the typical continuum structure and nonlinear material behavior make the kinematics modelling complex, especially in non-static motions. In this work, we proposed an LSTM-based pressure predictive control (PPC) for the motion control of a vertebraic soft robotic tail and the coordination with a quadruped robot. The PPC consists of an inverse kinematics (IK) model, a forward kinematics (FK) model and a pressure compensation (P-comp) model, and achieves non-static and quasi-static motion control of the tail. Compared with the IK-only model, the average RMSE of the PPC's simulation trajectories reduces by 69.8%, when executing target trajectories. In the coordinated motions of the soft tail quadruped, using a prediction data set to train the PPC enables next-moment action prediction and reduces computation time by 60.9%, which enhances the real-time response of the tail to match the quadruped torso's moving rate. The PPC provides a simple and effective method to model the soft tail for both non-static and quasi-static motion control, and grants the soft tail quadruped with the functionality of interacting with the environment.
tldr: The paper proposes an LSTM-based pressure predictive control (PPC) framework with inverse kinematics, forward kinematics, and pressure compensation models to achieve motion control of a vertebraic soft robotic tail and its coordination with a quadruped robot, reducing simulation trajectory RMSE by 69.8% and computation time by 60.9%.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于LSTM的压力预测控制（PPC）框架，结合逆运动学、正运动学和压力补偿模型，用于脊椎式软体机器人尾部的运动控制及其与四足机器人的协调，使仿真轨迹RMSE降低69.8%，计算时间减少60.9%。
summary_zh: 摘要：软体机器人因其安全的人机交互和灵活性而备受关注，但典型的连续体结构和非线性材料行为使得运动学建模复杂，尤其是在非静态运动中。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于LSTM的压力预测控制（PPC）方法，用于脊椎软体机器人尾部的运动控制及其与四足机器人的协调。PPC由逆运动学（IK）模型、正运动学（FK）模型和压力补偿（P-comp）模型组成，实现了尾部的非静态和准静态运动控制。与仅使用IK模型相比，在执行目标轨迹时，PPC仿真轨迹的平均均方根误差（RMSE）降低了69.8%。在软尾四足机器人的协调运动中，使用预测数据集训练PPC能够实现下一时刻的动作预测，并将计算时间减少60.9%，从而增强了尾部对四足躯干运动速率的实时响应能力。PPC为软体尾部的非静态和准静态运动控制提供了一种简单有效的建模方法，并赋予软尾四足机器人与环境交互的功能。

title: PIA: A Personal Intelligence Agent Turning Health Conversations into Records and Records into Understanding
summary: General-purpose agent memory summarizes conversations: it extracts salient snippets, embeds them, and retrieves the top-k into the prompt. A health agent cannot run on summaries: a dose becomes a sentence, "since last week" is resolved at the model's discretion, and a three-month glucose trend cannot be answered by text similarity. We present PIA, a personal intelligence agent deployed alongside a consumer health agent. PIA receives the agent's natural-language requests, decides for itself whether and how to write or read, and turns conversations into typed clinical records and records into a synthesized understanding of the user. Its memory harness consists of four controls -- extraction, memory, retrieval, and understanding -- each a domain-agnostic mechanism with a pluggable health module: schema, medical alias dictionary, knowledge graph, and temporal rules. We show how the same query receives a different answer as the memory injected into the response context deepens from one-dimensional recall, to a two-dimensional health snapshot, to a three-dimensional trajectory with causality, and report lessons from operation: self-reported health data are missing not at random, question phrasing governs the quality of synthesized understanding, and nearly a third of candidate causal links are structural noise that rules alone remove.
tldr: PIA is a personal intelligence agent memory system for consumer health agents that converts natural-language health conversations into typed clinical records and synthesizes them into multi-dimensional user health understanding, using pluggable health modules for schema, aliases, knowledge graphs, and temporal rules.
tldr_zh: PIA 是一个面向消费级健康助手的个人智能体记忆系统，将健康对话转化为结构化临床记录，并进一步合成多维度用户健康理解，通过可插拔的健康模块支持模式、别名、知识图谱和时间规则。
summary_zh: 通用型智能体记忆通过摘要来概括对话：它提取关键片段，将其嵌入向量，并将最相关的top-k结果注入提示中。然而，健康智能体无法依赖摘要运行：一次剂量变成了一个句子，“自上周以来”这一时间信息由模型自行裁量，而三个月的血糖趋势无法通过文本相似性来解答。我们提出了PIA，一个与消费级健康智能体协同部署的个人智能体。PIA接收智能体的自然语言请求，自行决定是否以及如何写入或读取，并将对话转化为类型化的临床记录，再将记录转化为对用户的综合理解。其记忆框架包含四个控制环节——提取、记忆、检索和理解——每个环节都是领域无关的机制，并配有可插拔的健康模块：模式、医学别名词典、知识图谱和时间规则。我们展示了当注入响应上下文中的记忆从一维回忆、到二维健康快照、再到带有因果关系的三维轨迹逐步深化时，同一查询如何得到不同答案，并报告了运行中的经验教训：自我报告的健康数据并非随机缺失，问题措辞决定了综合理解的质量，且近三分之一的候选因果关联是仅靠规则即可去除的结构性噪声。

title: CG-Probes: Recovering Guardrail Directions from Patient Query Embeddings
summary: Patient-facing AI assistants promise valuable support to patients, but incoming queries can pose medical risks. To create guardrails, we work with oncologists to define three ordinal risk axes: Medical Urgency, Psychological Urgency, and Topic Sensitivity. We propose Clinical Guardrail Probes (CG-Probes) to measure the risks from query embeddings. We probe for each axis in the normalized embedding space of frozen embedders via the difference-in-means method, treating each axis as a potential linear direction. To train the probes, we cluster 79,658 Czech oncology search queries with BERTopic and use these clusters to generate pairs of queries with contrastive risk levels via few-shot prompting. We evaluate the approach on 200 queries (90 real, 110 synthetic), each graded by two oncologists, against two open-weight LLMs and a frontier LLM. We find that urgency-based axes are recoverable as linear directions, and the probes are competitive with open-weight LLMs (no significant differences in quadratic-weighted kappa) at a fraction of the latency. Each axis yields a scalar score that clinicians can inspect and use to set escalation thresholds. The pipeline requires only search logs, axis definitions, and black-box access to the embedding model, suggesting transferability across healthcare domains. Robust validation on new queries and axes remains future work.
tldr: The paper introduces CG-Probes, a method to detect medical risk in patient query embeddings by training linear probes for urgency/topic sensitivity axes using clustered oncology search logs, showing competitive performance with LLMs at lower latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CG-Probes方法，利用聚类后的肿瘤科搜索日志训练线性探针，从患者查询嵌入中检测医疗紧急性、心理紧急性与话题敏感性等风险轴，在低延迟下达到与开源LLM相当的效果。
summary_zh: 患者面向的AI助手有望为患者提供宝贵支持，但收到的查询可能带来医疗风险。为了建立防护措施，我们与肿瘤学家合作定义了三个有序风险轴：医疗紧迫性、心理紧迫性和话题敏感性。我们提出了临床防护探针（CG-Probes）来测量查询嵌入中的风险。我们通过均值差方法，在冻结嵌入器的归一化嵌入空间中探测每个轴，将每个轴视为潜在的线性方向。为了训练探针，我们使用BERTopic对79，658个捷克肿瘤学搜索查询进行聚类，并利用这些聚类通过少样本提示生成具有对比风险水平的查询对。我们在200个查询（90个真实查询，110个合成查询）上评估了该方法，每个查询由两名肿瘤学家评分，并与两个开放权重LLM及一个前沿LLM进行比较。我们发现基于紧迫性的轴可作为线性方向恢复，且探针在二次加权kappa上无显著差异的情况下与开放权重LLM表现相当，而延迟仅为其一小部分。每个轴产生一个标量分数，临床医生可检查该分数并据此设置升级阈值。该流程仅需搜索日志、轴定义以及嵌入模型的黑盒访问权限，表明其可迁移至其他医疗领域。在新查询和轴上的稳健验证仍是未来工作。

title: BreathGRU: A Novel Semi-Supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit Framework for Speech and Breath Segmentation for Respiratory Audio
summary: Speech-breath segmentation is a fundamental preprocessing step in respiratory audio analysis, enabling applications such as respiratory acoustic biomarker extraction, lung function prediction and disease monitoring. Existing approaches, including threshold methods, Fourier Transform-based techniques, and unsupervised and pretrained voice activity detection (VAD) models, primarily focus on speech detection and often classify breathing events as non-speech or silence, limiting their applicability for precise breath detection. To address this limitation, we propose BreathGRU, a semi-supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) framework specifically designed for speech-breath segmentation. The proposed framework combines frame-level acoustic feature extraction with bidirectional recurrent modelling, pseudo-label refinement and duration-constrained Segmental Viterbi decoding to produce speech and breath segmentation. BreathGRU was evaluated against the existing approaches, using manually annotated recordings. Performance was assessed using event-based, time-based, overlap-based, duration-based and boundary-based segmentation metrics. Experiment results demonstrated that BreathGRU achieved the highest breath event recall (0.83), the lowest onset-localisation error (0.14s) and the highest Mean Match Intersection over Union (0.81), with competitive overall segmentation performance compared to large pretrained VAD models like Silero. Qualitative evaluation on manually annotated recordings further showed close agreement between BreathGRU and manual annotation, with better breath detection compared to Silero. These findings demonstrate that explicit breath event modelling provides advantages over general-purpose VAD models and establish BreathGRU as an effective speech-breath segmentation framework which can be applied for respiratory audio analysis and pulmonary healthcare applications.
tldr: BreathGRU is a semi-supervised BiGRU-based framework for jointly segmenting speech and breath in respiratory audio, using acoustic features, pseudo-label refinement, and Viterbi decoding. It outperforms prior breath detection approaches and matches large pretrained VAD models on segmentation metrics.
tldr_zh: BreathGRU 是一个基于半监督双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）的语音与呼吸分割框架，结合声学特征、伪标签精炼和维特比解码，在呼吸音频中联合分割语音与呼吸事件；实验表明其呼吸检测性能优于传统方法，并与大规模预训练 VAD 模型相当。
summary_zh: 语音-呼吸分割是呼吸音频分析中的基础预处理步骤，支持呼吸声学生物标志物提取、肺功能预测和疾病监测等应用。现有方法包括阈值法、基于傅里叶变换的技术以及无监督和预训练的语音活动检测（VAD）模型，这些方法主要聚焦于语音检测，往往将呼吸事件归类为非语音或静音，限制了其在精确呼吸检测中的适用性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了BreathGRU，一种专门用于语音-呼吸分割的半监督双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）框架。该框架结合了帧级声学特征提取、双向循环建模、伪标签精炼以及时长约束的分段维特比解码，以生成语音和呼吸分割结果。我们使用手动标注的录音，将BreathGRU与现有方法进行了评估。性能通过基于事件、基于时间、基于重叠、基于时长和基于边界的分割指标进行衡量。实验结果表明，BreathGRU实现了最高的呼吸事件召回率（0.83）、最低的起始点定位误差（0.14秒）和最高的平均匹配交并比（0.81），同时与大型预训练VAD模型（如Silero）相比，整体分割性能具有竞争力。对人工标注录音的定性评估进一步显示，BreathGRU与人工标注之间具有高度一致性，且在呼吸检测方面优于Silero。这些发现表明，显式呼吸事件建模相比通用VAD模型具有优势，并确立了BreathGRU作为一种有效的语音-呼吸分割框架，可应用于呼吸音频分析和肺部医疗保健应用。

title: How Far Can INRs Go? Cross-Domain Parameter-efficient INR-Based Semantic Segmentation for Brain MRI
summary: Biomedical image segmentation is central to medical image analysis, but practical deployment often faces limited annotations, memory constraints, and cross-site distribution shifts. Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently emerged as a lightweight alternative for semantic segmentation, achieving competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters than conventional architectures. However, the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and domain generalization abilities of INR-based segmentation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study these questions in the context of cross-domain brain MRI segmentation. We analyze INR-based segmentation across low-parameter regimes, comparing it with conventional pipelines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Surprisingly, we find that INR-based models do not simply improve with increasing parameter budget. Their advantage is most pronounced under low-parameter and limited-augmentation settings, while U-Net-based models benefit more from larger capacity and standard augmentation. We also investigate how INRs encode semantic information in their hidden features and show that complementary segmentation-relevant structure is distributed across multiple INR layers. Building on this insight, we introduce HierINRSeg, a hierarchical INR-based architecture that aggregates multi-layer representations for improved robustness and generalization. Extensive experiments show that HierINRSeg consistently outperforms MetaSeg, a strong recent INR-based segmentation baseline, with an average improvement of 5.6 percentage points in Dice for the in-domain test set and 8.2 percentage points out-of-domain. Overall, our analysis identifies the conditions under which INR-based segmentation is most effective, providing concrete guidance for model selection and future research.
tldr: Studies INR-based brain MRI segmentation, showing it excels in low-parameter/low-augmentation settings; proposes HierINRSeg that aggregates multi-layer INR features and improves Dice over MetaSeg by +5.6 in-domain and +8.2 out-of-domain.
tldr_zh: 研究基于隐式神经表示（INR）的脑MRI分割，发现其在低参数、低增强场景下优势明显；提出HierINRSeg聚合多层INR特征，在域内/域外Dice上比MetaSeg平均提升5.6/8.2个百分点。
summary_zh: 生物医学图像分割是医学图像分析的核心，但在实际部署中常面临标注有限、内存约束以及跨站点分布偏移等挑战。隐式神经表示（INRs）近年作为一种轻量级语义分割替代方案出现，能以远少于传统架构的参数实现具有竞争力的性能。然而，基于INR的分割机制、扩展行为及域泛化能力仍未得到充分理解。在本工作中，我们在跨域脑MRI分割背景下研究这些问题。我们分析了低参数设置下的INR分割，并在域内和域外场景中与传统流程进行比较。令人惊讶的是，我们发现基于INR的模型并非随参数预算增加而简单提升。其优势在低参数和有限增强设置下最为显著，而基于U-Net的模型则更多受益于更大容量和标准增强。我们还研究了INR如何在其隐藏特征中编码语义信息，并表明互补的分割相关结构分布在多个INR层中。基于这一见解，我们提出了HierINRSeg，一种分层INR架构，通过聚合多层表示来提高鲁棒性和泛化能力。大量实验表明，HierINRSeg持续优于MetaSeg——一种近期强力的基于INR的分割基线，在域内测试集上Dice平均提升5.6个百分点，域外提升8.2个百分点。总体而言，我们的分析识别了基于INR的分割最有效的条件，为模型选择和未来研究提供了具体指导。
